description: Hand-maintained ground truth for `jankhunt42 map` run on this repository. Written from reading the source and workflows, never generated by the tool. Update it deliberately when the repository's real connectivity changes.

edges.why: every workflow run receives a token
every workflow run receives a token
permissions: id-token: write (Sigstore signing for build provenance)

notes: jankhunt42 has no database, storage, or queue dependencies; any such node in a self-map is a false positive. Since 4.6.0 it makes no network calls outside `sandbox --fetch`, whose origins come from the operator at run time, so no static edge is expected for it.
